question: A retailer permits a trade discount of 25%, followed by a cash discount of 8%, on an article. The net percentage of discount is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net Discount % = x + y − (x × y)/100

Here, x = 25 and y = 8

Net Discount % = 25 + 8 − (25 × 8)/100

Net Discount % = 33 − 200/100 = 33 − 2 = 31%

**∴ The correct answer is 31%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Trade Discount = 25%

Cash Discount = 8%

Formula used:

Selling Price (SP) = Marked Price (MP) × (100 − D₁)% × (100 − D₂)%
